text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as we returned from our outing—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm, a phone call...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. —Yes, this is Air Groove.
Yes... Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So, someone has taken them in."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The call was from an animal rescue organization.
They had finally found someone to adopt the puppy Air Groove was fostering.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Apparently, they'll be coming to the academy tomorrow to pick it up.
choice_data_list: It's going to be lonely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...She's sharp.
She pays close attention even to our expressions."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is a farewell that must come, and one that should be celebrated.
If you're going to see me off tomorrow, wipe that look off your face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And in the blink of an eye, the day had passed,
and the time for farewell had arrived."

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Waf.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Waah. Her coat looks glossy and full of energy!
You took really great care of her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, it's nothing special at all—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thoroughly and completely~!
I've got the basic commands down pat!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, her best trick is 'Fetch'!
Right, Groove-san?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't butt in, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm just glad to see
you were able to have a good time.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm going to take super good care of you!
Come on, over here.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text:
Whine...?
Woof, woof.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, over by Groove-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey!!
Didn't you hear me say "come here"?!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Wah-woof!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You already know the command, don't you?
...Now, go back to your master.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The puppy turned its back on Air Groove
and trotted off toward its new owner...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is fine. Just like this.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Does Groove-san's Trainer
think so too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by Fine Motion's question,
without thinking, I turned toward the collector—
choice_data_list: Could I have just a little more time?
Have you decided on a name yet?
Can I come see you again?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh... H-Hey, what are you doing all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! For this little one's sake,
please make sure to do that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For her sake, too...
choice_data_list: Even if you try to hide it, your feelings still come through.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: ...*whimper*

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You..., gh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha.
Truly a clever one."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Should we leave the two of them alone for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Waf! Waf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Even if you get hungry, don't eat food off the ground.
Drink plenty of water. And don't sleep in weird places.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And then... and then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. There's just too much I want to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a little while, Air Groove bid her farewells
with an honest, open heart.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
A name, you ask?
No, not yet... I was thinking I'd decide after seeing its face, but—

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: ...Woof.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Air Groove-san.
Would you mind giving it a name, if you'd like?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh!? M... Me!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah, godparent! Sounds great~!
Go ahead and do it, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't say that so lightly!
It's a gift of a lifetime, and you—

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Please.
For this child's sake as well... please, by all means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove stared at the puppy in silence
for a while...
Eventually, she slowly opened her mouth and murmured.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then... um.
Please call me "Kaede."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Maple? I see, I see!
Something like "wishing you colorful, happy days," right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Groove-san♪
That's such a gentle name.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I pray that it is so.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stay healthy and take care, Kaede.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The puppy barked energetically
in response to Air Groove's gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Adopter
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! My place is pretty close by.
I think the park near the academy
would make a great walking route!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh... I-Is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you weren't going far away after all~!
That's such a relief, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦ N-No, but you see,
it would be better for them to forget about me as soon as possibleâ¦â¦

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Waf!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...You bark with such intelligent eyes,
like you'll remember me forever~

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mm, hmm...
choice_data_list: Should we add it to our running course?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: S-Shut up!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Every once in a while is fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Groove began asking me to "occasionally" change her running course.
